def num(value, fallback):
	try:
		return float(str(value).replace("%", "").replace("x", "").replace("deg", "").strip())
	except Exception:
		return fallback


def fmt(value):
	text = str(round(value, 3))
	if text.endswith(".0"):
		text = text[:-2]
	return text


def clamp(value, low, high):
	return min(max(value, low), high)


doc = str(props.get("doc") or "editor").strip()
if doc not in ["editor", "clients", "email", "payout"]:
	doc = "editor"
ratio = str(props.get("ratio") or "16/10").replace(" ", "")
if ratio not in ["16/10", "4/3", "21/9", "16/9", "1/1"]:
	ratio = "16/10"
zoom = clamp(num(props.get("zoom"), 2), 1, 4)
focus = str(props.get("focus") or "50% 50%").replace(",", " ").split()
ox = clamp(num(focus[0] if len(focus) > 0 else 50, 50), 0, 100)
oy = clamp(num(focus[1] if len(focus) > 1 else ox, 50), 0, 100)
shot = str(props.get("screenshot") or "").strip()
component.ratio = ratio.replace("/", " / ")
component.z = fmt(zoom)
component.ox = fmt(ox) + "%"
component.oy = fmt(oy) + "%"
component.rot = fmt(clamp(num(props.get("rotation"), -1), -8, 8)) + "deg"
component.w = fmt(clamp(num(props.get("width"), 40), 20, 60)) + "em"
component.zoom_label = fmt(zoom) + "x"
component.doc = doc
component.is_editor = doc == "editor"
component.is_clients = doc == "clients"
component.is_email = doc == "email"
component.is_payout = doc == "payout"
component.has_shot = len(shot) > 0
component.show_doc = len(shot) == 0
component.shot = "true" if len(shot) > 0 else "false"
